name: Frontier Ladders
description: The Frontier logic, maths and coding tests rebuilt as ten-rung difficulty ladders: deduction grids, knights and knaves, shortest plans, exact maths and engineering. In the November 2026 blind test, Deduction Grid, Knights & Knaves and Shortest Plans separated small, mid and top models; Exact Maths stopped the top model at level 8; Engineering was cleared to level 10 by mid and top models and separates small models only. The headline is the ladder height: the highest level passed reliably with every level below it. Its own leaderboard, never mixed into the Standard or Frontier Index. Long replies: check the Cost Planner first.
